links.title: CUET (UG) 2026 question papers
links.note: NTA does not publish the question papers openly. Each candidate can view only their own paper after logging in with their application number and password.

links.title: CUET (UG) 2026 final answer keys
links.note: One file for every paper, by exam date, shift and subject code. It lists NTA's question id and the correct option id. It does not contain the questions.
